name: eu_vat_validate
description: Check EU VAT identification numbers offline: each member state's format and check-digit algorithm (Austria to Slovakia, Greece as EL, Spain's NIF forms, the Dutch mod-97 numbers) plus XI for Northern Ireland. Says whether a number is well formed; whether it is registered is VIES's answer.

vat.description: With its country prefix; spaces, dots and dashes ignored

country.description: Prefix to assume when the numbers have none

catalog.source: national VAT number algorithms as implemented and documented by python-stdnum (github.com/arthurdejong/python-stdnum); EU Commission VIES format rules
